title: Financial Planning Services | Vertical Wealth
description: Wealth plans, portfolio management, estate planning, risk management and more. Holistic, fiduciary, fee-based financial planning from Vertical Wealth.

blocks.headline: Holistic planning, rooted in faith
blocks.body: Vertical Wealth takes a holistic, values-driven approach to financial planning. Our service is fiduciary and fee-based, customized to your specific needs. It all starts with a free discovery call, where we get to know you and your goals.

items.title: Wealth plan
items.body: We help you evaluate your current situation and build a plan to pursue true wealth and the goals and dreams that matter most to you.

items.title: Portfolio management
items.body: Investment management that aims for capital growth and preservation through diversification, asset allocation and long-term strategies.

items.title: Life goals blueprinting
items.body: A deeper look at your purpose and passions in life, brought into line with your action plan for intentional living.

items.title: Estate planning
items.body: A road map of your wishes and intentions, so you can plan the legacy you've always wanted to leave.

items.title: Risk management
items.body: We assess your exposure to potential loss and pitfalls, then help put the appropriate tools and protection in place.

items.title: Business development and transitions
items.body: A coaching and training environment, with the tools you need to build, grow and transition your business.

items.title: Real estate services
items.body: Knowledge and resources for acquiring personal and business property as you continue to grow.

blocks.heading: Fiduciary and fee-based
blocks.body:
Our service is fiduciary and fee-based. Advisory fees are a percentage of the assets we manage. The full fee schedule is in our Form ADV, available on request.

In a world of shifting values, we ground our advice in timeless truth. A few core biblical principles shape how we see wealth, purpose and stewardship. [Read about our approach](/our-approach).

blocks.heading: Get clarity over complexity
blocks.body: Live boldly. Give generously. Leave a legacy. It starts with a 15-minute, no-pressure discovery call with Brian. Bring your questions; there's no need to bring statements.
